issue.detail: Spec does not define whether prev_in history updates during synchronous reset; contract assumes it does, enabling capture spanning reset.
issue.spec_evidence: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
issue.alternative: prev_in is cleared or not updated during reset, so a pre-reset 1 followed by 0 on the first released cycle is not captured and out stays 0.
